newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ICE sees strong earnings growth for Richter.
newsitem.headline: ICE sees strong earnings growth for Richter.

text.p: Hungarian pharmaceuticals company Richter Gedeon Rt is well-positioned to post significant earnings growth, while its share prices does not fully reflect these opportunities, an analyst report said.
"This growth potential, we believe, is not fully reflected in the share price," Rudi Voros, analyst at ICE Securities said in a research on the Hungarian share market, dated January 28.
"Accordingly, we reconfirm our buy recommendation," the London-based analyst said.
ICE said a number of factors entitled Richter for the earnings growth.

"Richter Gedeon with its strong management, market leader status in CIS markets, diversified product portfolio and strong distribution network world-wide, is poised for substantial earnings growth in the medium to longer term," Voros said.

ICE forecast Richter's net profit to rise to 13.97 billion forints on sales of 46.2 billion forints in 1997, from a net profit of 9.02 billion on sales of 26.61 billion in the January-September period of 1996.
ICE forecast Richter's net profit at 11.095 billion forints on sales of 35 billion for 1996.
Richter, like almost all Budapest-bourse listed companies, are still ahead of releasing its preliminiary 1996 results. Budapest-bourse listed companies have to release their figures by February 15.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange Richter shares traded at 11,100 forints, up 100 from Friday's close, at 1117 GMT on Monday.
